creator: A fictional woman in her mid-20s, shoulder-length dark brown curly hair half up in a tortoiseshell claw clip with a few loose strands, light freckles, minimal makeup, small gold hoop earrings. She wears an oversized faded sage-green crewneck sweatshirt with a small black wireless clip-on mic on the collar.
setting: Sitting cross-legged on an unmade bed in a small, lived-in apartment bedroom: plain off-white wall, a slightly crooked framed print, a laundry basket at the edge of frame, a phone charger cable on the rumpled duvet.
lighting: Late-afternoon window light from her left, soft and uneven, the window side a little overexposed, a warm bedside lamp glowing on her right. Real skin texture, no beauty filter.

beats.action: She leans toward the lens with a half-laugh and raised eyebrows, like she is confessing something slightly embarrassing.
beats.says: I thought we were broke growing up because Mom clipped coupons.

beats.action: She pulls the phone a little closer, a natural handheld punch-in, tilts her head and gives a small knowing smile and a nod.
beats.says: Now Lodavo gives you free tickets for saving.
